# LinguaFlow — Data Processing Addendum (Business plan)

*LinguaFlow B.V. (fictional vendor), Amsterdam. DPA version 4.0, March 2026. Attached to a quote for
"LinguaFlow Business, 15 seats" that Olga Petrenko requested on 2 October 2026 and forwarded to IT.*

## 1. Scope

1.1 This DPA applies to personal data that LinguaFlow processes on behalf of the Customer when the
Customer's users use **LinguaFlow Business** (web app, API and browser extension signed in to a
Business account).

1.2 **This DPA does not apply to the free LinguaFlow browser extension or to personal accounts.** Use
of the free extension is governed by the LinguaFlow Consumer Terms and Privacy Policy, under which
LinguaFlow is the controller of the texts submitted.

## 2. Roles

2.1 For LinguaFlow Business, the Customer is the controller and LinguaFlow is the processor.

## 3. What LinguaFlow processes

3.1 Texts, documents and web-page content submitted for translation or rewriting, which may include
any personal data the user includes; user account details (name, email); usage metadata.

## 4. Use of texts

4.1 **Business plan:** LinguaFlow does not store submitted texts after the translation is returned
("zero retention"), except for up to 24 hours in encrypted logs for troubleshooting. Texts are **not**
used to train or improve LinguaFlow models.

4.2 *For comparison (not part of this DPA):* under the Consumer Terms, texts submitted through the free
extension may be retained for up to 18 months and used to improve LinguaFlow's services, including
model training.

## 5. Location

5.1 Processing takes place in the European Union (Ireland, Netherlands). Support staff in the United
Kingdom may access account metadata, not texts.

## 6. Sub-processors

| Sub-processor | Purpose | Location |
|---|---|---|
| EuroCloud Hosting B.V. | Hosting | Netherlands, Ireland |
| MailRelay Ltd | Transactional email | Ireland |

LinguaFlow gives 30 days' notice of new sub-processors. The Customer may object; if the parties cannot
agree, the Customer may terminate the affected service with a pro-rata refund.

## 7. Security

7.1 Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). ISO/IEC 27001 certified. Annual penetration
test; summary available on request.

7.2 Breach notification to the Customer without undue delay and in any case within 48 hours of
LinguaFlow becoming aware.

## 8. Deletion and exit

8.1 On termination, account data is deleted within 30 days. The Customer can export glossaries at any
time.

## 9. Admin controls (Business)

- Single sign-on (Google Workspace).
- Admin can force the extension to sign in to the Business account and block personal accounts on
  managed browsers.
- Usage report per user (characters translated per day).

## 10. Price (from the quote)

LinguaFlow Business: € 12 per user per month, billed annually (15 seats: € 2,160 a year).
